in_sanskrit.name: अमितव

in_marathi.name: Amitava
in_marathi.long_meaning: Amitava हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Amitava is derived from Sanskrit roots 'amita' meaning immeasurable, infinite and 'ava' meaning flow or desire. In Hindu mythology, it is the name of several deities and sages, symbolizing endless love, compassion, and wisdom.
